name: flashchat-core
description: Pure logic shared by the Flash Chat engine and the POS. No I/O.

scripts.verify: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version,t=require('child_process').execSync('git describe --tags --abbrev=0').toString().trim();if(t!=='v'+v)throw new Error(`tag ${t} != version ${v}`)"
